requestExample.sql_fmt:
SELECT
    cr.username              AS room_wxid,
    cr.owner                 AS manager_wxid,
    c_room.nick_name         AS nickname,
    c_room.small_head_url    AS avatar,

    CASE
        WHEN cr.owner = '{}' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_manager,

    COUNT(cm.member_id)      AS total_member,

    GROUP_CONCAT(c_member.UserName) AS member_list

FROM chat_room cr

-- 群本身在 contact 表中的信息
LEFT JOIN contact c_room
    ON c_room.UserName = cr.username

-- 群成员关系表
LEFT JOIN chatroom_member cm
    ON cm.room_id = cr.id

-- 群成员在 contact 表中的信息
LEFT JOIN contact c_member
    ON c_member.id = cm.member_id

GROUP BY cr.id;
